# Game Idea: Neon Escape

An endless runner set on a neon‑styled HTML canvas. A glowing square moves forward automatically; tap/click to jump over or slide under incoming neon barriers. The game ends when the player collides with a barrier or falls off the platform. Aim for the highest survival time.

1: // Neon Escape – enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas id="game" assumed in the surrounding HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return; // abort if missing
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // audio setup
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
20:   }
21:   // fullscreen canvas
22:   canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
23:   canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
24: 
25:   // particle pool for jump/land effects
26:   const particles = [];
27: 
28:   const player = {
29:   w: 40,
30:   h: 40,
31:   x: 80,
32:   y: canvas.height - 100,
33:   vy: 0,
34:   color: '#0ff', // neon cyan
35:   onGround: true,
36:   prevOnGround: true,
37: };
38:   const GRAVITY = 0.8;
39:   const JUMP = -15;
40:   const obstacles = [];
41:   let lastObstacle = 0;
42:   let score = 0;
43: 
44:   // input – tap/click to jump
45:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', async () => {
46:     // resume audio context on first interaction
47:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') await audioCtx.resume();
48:     // play jump sound
49:     playTone(440, 100);
50:     if (player.onGround) {
51:     if (player.onGround) {
52:       player.vy = JUMP;
53:       player.onGround = false;
54:     }
55:   });
56: 
57:   function spawnObstacle() {
58:     // neon barrier with slight vertical variance and color variation
59:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20; // 20‑50px
60:     const gap = Math.random() * 200 + 150; // distance to next barrier
61:     obstacles.push({
62:       x: canvas.width + size,
63:       y: canvas.height - size - 60,
64:       w: size,
65:       h: size,
66:       speed: 6,
67:       color: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 80%, 60%)`,
68:     });
69:     lastObstacle = performance.now() + gap;
70:   }
71: 
72:   function update(dt) {
73:     // particles
74:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
75:       const p = particles[i];
76:       p.vy += GRAVITY * 0.2;
77:       p.x += p.vx;
78:       p.y += p.vy;
79:       p.life -= dt;
80:       if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
81:     }
82: 
83:     // player physics
84:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
85:     player.y += player.vy;
86: 
87:     // ground handling & landing particles
88:     if (player.y + player.h >= canvas.height - 60) {
89:       player.y = canvas.height - 60 - player.h;
90:       player.vy = 0;
91:       player.onGround = true;
92:       if (!player.prevOnGround) {
93:         // landing sound
94:         playTone(220, 150);
95:         for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
96:           particles.push({
97:             x: player.x + player.w / 2,
98:             y: player.y + player.h,
99:             vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2,
100:             vy: -Math.random() * 3 - 1,
101:             r: Math.random() * 3 + 2,
102:             life: 300,
103:             maxLife: 300,
104:           });
105:         }
106:       }
107:     } else {
108:       player.onGround = false;
109:     }
110:     player.prevOnGround = player.onGround;
111: 
112:     // obstacles movement
113:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
114:       const o = obstacles[i];
115:       o.x -= o.speed;
116:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
117:     }
118:     if (performance.now() > lastObstacle) spawnObstacle();
119: 
120:     // collision detection (AABB)
121:     for (const o of obstacles) {
122:       if (
123:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
124:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
125:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
126:         player.y + player.h > o.y
127:       ) {
128:         cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
129:         alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 1000));
130:         return;
131:       }
132:     }
133: 
134:     score += dt;
135:   }
136: 
137:   function draw() {
138:     // background gradient
139:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
140:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0d0d0d');
141:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
142:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
143:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
144: 
145:     // ground line
146:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
147:     ctx.lineWidth = 4;
148:     ctx.beginPath();
149:     ctx.moveTo(0, canvas.height - 60);
150:     ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, canvas.height - 60);
151:     ctx.stroke();
152: 
153:     // particles – glowing circles
154:     for (const p of particles) {
155:       const alpha = Math.max(p.life / p.maxLife, 0);
156:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,255,255,${alpha})`;
157:       ctx.beginPath();
158:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
159:       ctx.fill();
160:     }
161: 
162:     // player – glowing square
163:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
164:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
165:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
166:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
167:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
168: 
169:     // obstacles – neon bars with per‑obstacle color
170:     for (const o of obstacles) {
171:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
172:       ctx.shadowColor = o.color;
173:       ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
174:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
175:     }
176:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
177: 
178:     // score
179:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
180:     ctx.font = '20px monospace';
181:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 1000), 20, 30);
182:   }
183: 
184:   let last = performance.now();
185:   let animId;
186:   function loop() {
187:     const now = performance.now();
188:     const dt = now - last;
189:     last = now;
190:     update(dt);
191:     draw();
192:     animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
193:   }
194: 
195:   // start the game
196:   spawnObstacle();
197:   loop();
198: })();

(End of file - total 198 lines)
</content>
